criteria.requirement: Extend the delivered PathLike-aware template lookup: give MakoTemplate/Jinja2Template/CheetahTemplate their own engine suffixes ahead of existing legacy extensions, and allow BaseTemplate instances to append explicit extensions without mutating parent or other instances. Extend search to accept an explicit extension sequence used by initialization; preserve PathLike names/directories, direct filename search, lookup priority and legacy .tpl fallback. Validate bad path-like suffixes and prove SimpleTemplate actually renders an instance-only extension without requiring optional engines.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
